credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Frontal half length portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on a white cushion against an adobe wall  (in the Abiquiu house?), her hair is pulled back from her face, she faces towards the camera with eyes closed,  hands are folded in her lap; she wears one of her black wrap dresses, a white v-neck shirt or dress, her Alexander Calder pin, and her favorite Taxco black suede / sterling silver belt.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
